products.name: Headliner
products.note: Podcast/video promotion; audiogram generation; social media; content marketing

reading.body:
Headliner is a video generation and editing product for podcast and video promotion, and the data records nothing about the compute, buildings, or power behind it.

The product description is narrow and functional: audiogram generation, social media clips, content marketing. That places it in the category of tools that turn existing audio or video into short promotional assets, a workflow that runs on inference and media encoding rather than on training large models.

Nothing here indicates scale. There is no funding figure, no customer count, no model provider, no data center, no power contract, and no mention of where the work runs. A reader looking for the compute chain behind this company will not find it in this record.

What the data does establish is that the company exists, has a live website, and ships one product. Everything about its cost structure, its dependence on rented GPUs, and its exposure to electricity prices is absent.
